description: This file defines the interface for fallback SPROM support in the SSB (Sonics Silicon Backplane) subsystem, including function declarations for registration and retrieval of SPROM data.

methods.name: ssb_fbs_register
methods.description: Registers the fallback SPROM functionality within the SSB subsystem.

methods.name: ssb_get_fallback_sprom
methods.description: Retrieves the fallback SPROM data for a given SSB device.
